title: vidtoolz.resolveProductionReadSessionProfile.v1
description: Sealed manifest of an isolated Resolve session profile: the link between an ACCEPTED production-read grant and one concrete Resolve process. Produced only by tools/generate_session_profile.py from an ACCEPTED authority record, its LIVE policy and the exact worker bytes. The profile directory it seals registers EXACTLY ONE Project Library — the authorized local Disk library — so a session launched with it cannot have any other library open, and identity no longer depends on interrogating a pre-existing handle. `governed` is deterministic (same inputs -> same governed_sha256) and is what the worker enforces; `provenance` records the runtime facts of this particular sealing. The worker refuses unless: the manifest digest matches its command-line pin, governed_sha256 matches the governed block, the authority/policy/worker/facade digests match the ones it verified itself, every sealed file still hashes to its recorded value, the registration file is still exactly registration_line, and the live Resolve process was started after seal_epoch with exactly profile_env pointing into profile_root.

governed_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators) of `governed`

session_id.description: deterministic digest of the grant this profile serves

authority_sha256.description: sha256 of the ACCEPTED authority record BYTES

policy_sha256.description: sha256 of the compiled policy FILE bytes: exactly the digest the worker is pinned to with --production-policy-sha256

worker_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact worker file permitted to use this profile

registration_line.description: the single Linux .dblist Disk registration the profile contains: '<name>:<canonical_root>::::DISK'

profile_env.description: environment variable -> path RELATIVE to provenance.profile_root; the attested process must carry exactly these absolute values

script_server_port.description: local Resolve scripting endpoint; every listening owner must be the attested process or a descendant of it

project_open_law.const: read the project the human already opened; never LoadProject/OpenProject/SetCurrentProject/SetCurrentDatabase

profile_root.description: absolute local directory the session must be launched with; ephemeral, never inside the operator's own Resolve configuration

seal_epoch.description: unix seconds at sealing; a Resolve process that started before this instant is never eligible

source_config.description: operator configuration directory the settings files were COPIED FROM; it is opened read-only and never modified, and its library list is never copied

files.description: relative path -> sha256 for every regular file in the sealed profile
